notes.title: Eternity Protectors 1.0 Release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39977675/d1871625fbb5ea7730744437326136911b2ad6f5.jpg[/img]

Hello Protectors!

Finally, the 1.0 version of the Eternity Protectors is released!

This release contains:

- The Forest Druid protector. It was about time.
    - Fight protecting the Forest Minions, instead of trying to beat the enemies. A complete different gameplay style!
- A new Last Boss spawning system, which takes in account which bosses you already beat.
- Many bug fixes.
- MANY more particles.

Still, there are more content to come, in special the last Difficulty setting, and more Protectors&Invaders.

Please submit your Feedback at Discord https://discord.gg/vB9M5SKQxu . 

Thank you very much for your support so far, and hope you survive.

Sao
Underway Gaming Studio

notes.title: Eternity Protectors Early Access 0.9.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey Protectors,

Our Protector Guardian (the only in front of the Fortress Barrier) was feeling unwell.
The Protector Captain (the girl with a bow behind the Fortress Barrier) gave him some slaps, and he should be moving again.

- Bugfix: Protector Guardian is now moving and fighting again.

That is it for now, see you soon in the 1.00 !!

Sao - Underway Gaming Studio

notes.title: Eternity Protector Early Access 0.9.00!! 1 Patch to go!
notes.content:
Hey Protectors!

0.9.00 Patch comes with myths and legends!

New Protector	"Shor, the Thundercloud Judge", comes to protect the Eternity Tree!

[*]   Have a permanent Thundercloud flying around the battlefield and exploding whatever is under it!
[*]   If your enemies are getting too personal, push them back to the start with your mighty Judgement Hammer, where the Thundercloud may be waiting for them!

New Invader "The Escapees of the Labyrinth Prison":

[*]   Monsters of myths escaped the Labyrinth Prison, which was powered by the Tree of Eternity.
[*]   The immortal Hydra attacks the Protectors with poisonous gas. And unlike other attacks, it doesn't goes away.
[*]   As the time goes by, more and more different monsters join the fight.

Many other changes were made. Please give your feedback at Discord: https://discord.gg/vB9M5SKQxu

------

Hope you survive,
Sao - Underway Gaming Studio

notes.title: Major Update - Early Access 0.8.00, the troubled seas!
notes.content:
Hey Protectors!

We are going into Patch Early Access 0.8, which means we have a big content update!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/SN0R80n.png[/img]

New Protector	"J. Pidgeon, the Whirl Pirate", comes to protect the Eternity Tree!

[*]   Shoot enemies anywhere past trees or barriers with a Flintlock instead of a bow!
[*]   Summon whirlpools to pull all enemies to the same place, then explode them with your cannon!

New Invader "The Queen of the Seven Seas":

[*]   No man can resist the voice of the Queen of the Seven Seas. Prepare to fight not only sea monsters, but pirates and thugs as well.
[*]   If she sings on the battlefield, your allies may forget they are in a fight. But the women, which may get even more motivated.
[*]   Aside her voice, be careful of her magic expanding water explosions.

Difficulty Balance:

[*]   On easy/normal/hard, a Minion Summoner can only be summoned if they are in less than 5/6/6. 
[*]   Barrier Summoners will still be summoned every time the Boss HP is under 40%. Clear the battlefield to prepare for the fight!

Graphics Update:

[*]    The Roots (Character selection screen) has been redesigned!

Particles Upgrade

[*]   Added new particles to many actions and interactions.

Bug fix:

[*]   Explosion particles won't fail to explode.
[*]   Credits aren't cut by the terrain.
[*]   Player Spirit can't go through walls on the Protector Selection screen.[/list]

------

This patch was delivered just in time, and the next one will be delivered in one week, with another new Protector and Invaders. Do your best to unlock the J. Pidgeon until next week.

As always, come meet me on Discord: https://discord.gg/vB9M5SKQxu

Hope you survive,
Sao - Underway Gaming Studio

notes.title: Apr. 18 Update - Access to the Credits!
notes.content:
Hello Protectors,

The last room with the Credits and the upcoming new Protector was inaccessible.

Now, if you defeat the last boss with the Meteor Mage, you are able to see the credits.

Btw, the new Protector should be with us in around 4 days.

See you soon, if you survive.

Sao.

notes.title: Early Access Patch Notes - Difficulty Balance
notes.content:
Hello, Protectors.

Since the game just launched, the Invaders are still warming up, so they are slower than usual.

Difficulty Balances
- Enraged Bosses now Attack once every 13/12/11 seconds based on difficulty chosen, up from 7 at all difficulties.

Bug Fix
- Barrier Leaders now correctly display red particles.

With those, unlocking characters past the second should be easier.

Hope you survive,
Underway Gaming Studio.
